Integration.Scope: Same website player configuration in the engine arena; the serialized website adapter is tested separately for decision parity.
Integration.Opponent: C# reconstruction/adaptation of Bridge Belot Multiplayer 2.06 by Valentin Tsekov (copyright 2001), under BelotGameEngine rules; original Windows executable was not run.
Integration.Uncertainty: One empirical standard error across mirrored whole-game pair means.
Integration.Machine: Intel Core i7-12700K, Windows; fixed work, eight workers.
Integration.PathNormalization: Only output and resolved input paths were normalized for publication; match data and settings are preserved.
